_comment: Standing geopolitical risk floor by country, applied to any supplier whose location matches. A country absent from this file carries no floor, which is the correct state for stable countries — do not add one just to make a country appear. level: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM. This floor can only raise a supplier's risk, never lower it, and on its own it does not move the pillar RAG score: only live news escalating above the floor counts as something that happened.

Russia.reason: Active conflict, comprehensive Western sanctions regime

Yemen.reason: Active armed conflict, Houthi attacks disrupting Red Sea shipping

Myanmar.reason: Civil war, military junta, Western sanctions

Israel.reason: Active military operations, regional escalation risk

Iran.reason: Comprehensive sanctions regime, regional proxy conflicts

China.reason: US-China trade war, Taiwan risk, export controls on tech

South Korea.reason: North Korea proximity, regional military tensions

India.reason: Border tensions with China and Pakistan

South Africa.reason: Economic instability, infrastructure challenges, energy crisis

Finland.reason: NATO frontline state, border with Russia
